description: Implementation of ClientSocketPoolManager and related socket pool management functions for network connections in Chromium project.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManager
classes.description: Manages socket pool configurations and socket request initialization.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Returns maximum sockets allowed per pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_pool
methods.description: Sets maximum sockets allowed per pool type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Returns maximum sockets allowed per group type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_group
methods.description: Sets maximum sockets allowed per group type.

methods.name: max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Returns maximum sockets allowed per proxy server for a pool type.

methods.name: set_max_sockets_per_proxy_server
methods.description: Sets maximum sockets allowed per proxy server for a pool type.

methods.name: unused_idle_socket_timeout
methods.description: Returns timeout duration for unused idle sockets.

methods.name: InitSocketHandleForHttpRequest
methods.description: Initializes a socket handle for an HTTP request.

methods.name: InitSocketHandleForWebSocketRequest
methods.description: Initializes a socket handle for a WebSocket request.

methods.name: PreconnectSocketsForHttpRequest
methods.description: Preconnects sockets for an HTTP request.
